description:
Make sense of work, money and Queensland concessions with Capable.

Capable helps people with disability organise information and prepare for conversations with government services, support workers and trusted people.

UNDERSTAND A SUPPORTED DSP INCOME SCENARIO
Enter gross fortnightly wages to explore an income-test estimate for the single adult circumstances Capable supports. Questions identify situations it cannot estimate, and missing or uncertain answers lead to guidance instead of a potentially misleading amount. Each result explains its limits and links to official information.

EXPLORE QUEENSLAND CONCESSIONS
Answer scheme-specific questions to see which concessions may be worth checking, what further information is needed, and where to find official application guidance.

KEEP NDIS BALANCE NOTES SEPARATE
Record a balance, its source and date, and whether it covers a whole plan or a funding period. Your entry is not verified by Capable and may not all be available to use now. NDIS funding stays separate from personal income.

EXPLORE EXAMPLE WORK ROLES
Compare illustrative roles with your work preferences and available hours. These are examples for planning, not live vacancies or job offers.

CHOOSE HOW YOU USE THE APP
Use Easy Read summaries, read-aloud and voice navigation on devices that support on-device speech recognition. Core tools work offline. No account is needed, and saving your answers on the device is optional.

Capable is an independent information and planning tool. It is not a government service and does not access Centrelink or NDIS accounts, submit claims, make eligibility decisions or provide financial advice. Check important decisions with the relevant official service. Figures and rules can change; the app shows its sources and verification information.
